systemStatus.headline: WED SEP 9, 9:15 AM PT RUN. THE OVERNIGHT EMERGENCY IS RESOLVED. PAYROLL IS IN -- Toast confirmed at 14:33Z that $17,991.53 was withdrawn 09:33 AM CST today for the Aug 23-Sep 5 cycle. FRIDAY SEP 11 PAY DATE IS SECURE. It posted one day late (an overdue notice went out at 11:01Z and Joal cleared it ~3.5 hours later). Note the actual withdrawal was $17,991.53, not the $29,853.57 estimate prior runs carried -- that estimate was a gross figure, not a shortfall. NOTHING IS BLOCKING TODAY'S SERVICE. THREE THINGS STILL WANT JOAL'S ATTENTION, in order. (1) TUESDAY'S LABOR RAN 33.5% OF NET. Sep 8 sales landed fine -- net $3,761.05, +3.0% vs last Tuesday -- but 10.3% under the 4-Tuesday average, while hourly labor cost $1,260.09 came in +10.1% ABOVE that same average. Spending more labor on less volume put labor at 33.5% of net against a 27.3% norm, a 6.2-point miss and the worst day in the recent set. Monday flexed correctly to 25.4%, so the scheduling discipline exists; Tuesday did not use it. Today is scheduled at 33.75 hours, UP 2.0 from Tuesday -- worth a look before service. (2) YELP AUDIENCE SIZE DROPPED FROM 'IDEAL' TO 'LIMITED' -- new this run and the likely cause of three days of thin delivery (~$0 Sunday, $6.60 Monday). Yelp warns control features raise cost-per-click. The 12 keywords and 5-mile radius are the constraint; widening either should restore reach. (3) THE BOTULISM REVIEW IS STILL PUBLIC AND STILL UNANSWERED -- carried forward from the 4 AM run, not re-verified here. Eight unreplied Brewhouse reviews total, ten drafts written, nothing posted. Recommend looping in your insurer and SB County Public Health before replying to that one. GOOD NEWS ELSEWHERE: Google Ads efficiency reversed hard in the right direction -- Sep 8 spent $32.79 (down $8.75) for 1,517 impressions (up 484) and 28 clicks at a $1.17 CPC, down from $1.73. That breaks the two-day slide, though both live campaigns remain policy-limited and Lunch -- the cheaper, higher-CTR campaign -- is only using 52% of its $25/day budget. Kitchen still runs ONE COOK for a third straight day.

yesterday.note: LIVE read, date range Yesterday (Sep 8, 2026). EFFICIENCY REVERSED SHARPLY FOR THE BETTER. Spend $32.79 (down $8.75) bought 1,517 impressions (UP 484) and 28 clicks (up 4), at a $1.17 average CPC -- down from $1.73 on Sep 7. That breaks the two-day deterioration the Sep 7 and Sep 8 runs flagged: versus Sep 7 ($41.54 / 1,033 impr / 24 clicks / $1.73 CPC), spend is DOWN 21% while impressions are UP 47% and clicks UP 17%. CTR did slip to 1.85% from 2.32% -- the extra reach is lower-intent -- but cost per click improved 32%, so the trade is favorable. CONVERSIONS READ 0.00 and are still flagged pending/calculating; the Sep 7 read showed 1.00, also provisional, and an in-product banner credits Brewhouse Dinner with 1.00 conversion 'this week'. Treat conversion counts as unreliable at this reporting lag. STRUCTURAL FLAG UNCHANGED AND NOW LONG-RUNNING: both live Search campaigns still read 'All ads limited by policy, Limited by search volume'. That policy limitation has persisted across many runs and is the ceiling on this account -- the efficiency gain above happened despite it, not because it was fixed. Worth one pass through the policy manager to see what is actually disapproved. Account budget $40.00/day; 2 drafts in progress.
